newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer March sales up.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer March sales up.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said Thursday that same-store sales for its Eddie Bauer unit rose seven percent for the five-week period of March versus the comparable period last year.
For the 13 weeks ended March 29, Eddie Bauer same-store sales increased four percent, the company said.
Spiegel said its total net sales for the period were $232.3 million, a decrease of four percent from the $241.6 million reported last year.
Year to date, total sales were $569.8 million, a decrease of three percent from the $589.5 million in the same period last year.

Spiegel noted that sales for this year's five-week period of March included the pre-Easter week ended March 29, 1997. Last year's five-week sales period excluded the pre-Easter sales week, the company said.
Spiegel is a specialty retailer of apparel and home furnishings through catalogs and retail stores.
